sumatra-pdf.remediation: SumatraPDF is missing, so no file can be printed on Windows. Install SumatraPDF, or place SumatraPDF.exe next to Pluryprint.exe.

libre-office.remediation: LibreOffice is missing, so Office, OpenDocument and RTF files cannot be printed. Download it free from https://www.libreoffice.org/download

chromium.remediation: Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome is missing, so HTML and Markdown files cannot be printed. Install Microsoft Edge (https://www.microsoft.com/edge) or Google Chrome (https://www.google.com/chrome).

pandoc.remediation: Pandoc is missing, so Markdown files cannot be printed. Download it from https://pandoc.org/installing.html

heif-codec.remediation: The HEIF image decoder is missing, so HEIC/HEIF photos cannot be printed. Install “HEIF Image Extensions” (and “HEVC Video Extensions” for .heic) from the Microsoft Store, then retry the job.

hevc-codec.remediation: The HEVC video decoder this HEIC photo needs is missing. Install “HEVC Video Extensions” from the Microsoft Store, then retry the job.

no-heif-decoder.remediation: No HEIF image decoder is available on this system. Convert the photo to JPEG or PNG first.

sips.remediation: sips, the macOS image tool, could not be found.

cups.remediation: The system print service (CUPS) could not be started. Check that printing is set up on this computer.

no-print-backend.remediation: Printing is not available on this platform.
